items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: I don't know anything further than that. It's Spencer Williams. Spencer, yeah. Spencer Williams. So I don't know.

ctx.x: I believe he was, and yet he never recorded.

Never recorded, no. Well, now I heard something different from that, to the truth, there's something that... late... No, no, no, no. A fellow from Indiana, Joe Russell Robinson. He commented on a tune that, St. Thomas Spencer's tunes that was played to some singer. He said, if you're listening to hear Williams play on that, he didn't, or he couldn't. He said, I'm the man that played to come in for that. That was Russell Roberts. I don't know anything further than that. It's Spencer Williams. Spencer, yeah.…
Well, don't you think this is probably Joplin on these roles that like this... I'm pretty sure they do. I mean, the label says just one thing. It says the title in Scott Joplin, and that's all.
